features.name: Create a New Database
features.description: Create a new Money Manager Ex database during first-time setup.
actions: Launch the app and dismiss the welcome screen if shown
Enter a database file name with the .mmb extension
Leave the password blank or enter a password to encrypt the database
On the DB Setup screen, tap Create New Account

features.name: Create First/New Account
features.description: Create a financial account with a name, type, currency, opening balance, and date.

features.name: Add a Transaction
features.description: Create a withdrawal, deposit, or transfer transaction with transaction details.
actions: Select Type: Withdrawal, Deposit, or Transfer
Optionally enter Transaction Number and Note

features.name: Edit / Delete / Modify a Transaction
features.description: Modify or remove a transaction from an account's transaction list.
actions: Navigate to the account's transaction list
Select Edit, Delete, Void, or another available action

features.name: Filter Transactions by Date Range
features.description: Filter an account's transaction list to a selected date range.
actions: View the updated filtered transaction list

features.name: Search/Sort Transactions
features.description: Search transactions by keyword or sort them by a selected field.
actions: Tap the Search icon and type a keyword
Or tap Sort and select a field

features.name: Mark Account as Favorite
features.description: Mark an account as a favorite using the star icon.
actions: Tap the Favorite star icon in the toolbar

features.name: Manage Accounts
features.description: Add new accounts or edit existing account information.
actions: Tap Add (+) to create a new account
Tap an existing account to view its transactions
Long-press an account and tap Edit to modify it

features.name: Set Up a Budget
features.description: Create a budget for a selected year and optionally a month.
actions: Tap the new budget to open it

features.name: Set/Edit a Category Budget Amount
features.description: Set or edit the frequency and amount for a category within a budget.

features.name: View Budget Details / Transactions
features.description: View transactions associated with a category in a budget.

features.name: Delete a Budget
features.description: Delete a budget from the budget list without affecting transactions.

features.name: Configure Budget View Options
features.description: Configure budget display and calculation options and select visible columns.
actions: Select or deselect Frequency, Amount, Estimate, Actual, Available, and Forecast Remain

features.name: Create a Recurring/Scheduled Transaction
features.description: Create a transaction that recurs on a configured schedule.
actions: Set Recurrence Type: Manual, Prompt, or Automatic

features.name: Respond to a Recurring Transaction Prompt
features.description: Respond to a prompt when a scheduled recurring transaction becomes due.

features.name: Manage Payees
features.description: Create, select, edit, or delete transaction payees.
actions: Open the Payee field while adding or editing a transaction, or navigate to Payees
Tap an existing payee to select it
Tap + to add a new payee
Long-press a payee to Edit or Delete

features.name: Manage Categories
features.description: Create, nest, edit, or delete transaction categories and subcategories.
actions: Open the Category field while adding or editing a transaction, or navigate to Categories
Tap + to add a new category
Optionally select a parent category to nest it
Long-press a category to Edit or Delete

features.name: View a Built-In Report
features.description: Open built-in financial reports and optionally configure their period, sorting, filtering, or chart view.
actions: Optionally select period, sort order, or account filter
For Summary of Accounts, optionally toggle chart view

features.name: Run a General Report
features.description: Run a previously loaded SQL or HTML general report.
actions: Select a previously loaded SQL or HTML report
Tap the report to run or view it

features.name: Track Stock/Mutual Fund Investments
features.description: Add and track stocks or mutual fund holdings in an investment account.

features.name: Add a Stock Transaction
features.description: Record a stock transaction such as buying or selling shares.
actions: Open a stock within the investment account

features.name: Track Fixed Assets
features.description: Create and track fixed assets with their type, value, and date.

features.name: Manage Currencies & Exchange Rates
features.description: Add currencies and configure their exchange rates relative to the base currency.
actions: Set its exchange rate relative to the Base Currency

features.name: Set Up Data Sync
features.description: Open a Money Manager Ex database stored with a supported cloud provider and enable offline availability when supported.
actions: On the create or open screen, tap Open Database
Use the system file picker to navigate to a cloud provider
Enable Offline availability in the cloud app if supported

features.name: Set/Change Database Password
features.description: Set or change the password used to protect the database.
actions: Tap Set Password or Change Password

features.name: Enable Fingerprint/Biometric Lock
features.description: Enable fingerprint or biometric unlocking for the app.
actions: Confirm with the device biometric prompt

features.name: Import/Export via QIF or CSV
features.description: Import financial data from QIF or CSV files or export data to a selected destination.
actions: Navigate to Settings or the account options menu
Tap Import and select a .qif or .csv file using the file picker

features.name: Configure App Settings
features.description: Configure general application behavior such as financial year, recurring transactions, and theme.
actions: Configure options such as financial year start, automatic recurring transactions, or theme
